name: exiled-survivors
description: Vampire Survivors style top-down survival game (Phaser 4 + Vite + TypeScript, served by a Cloudflare Worker)

scripts.dev:api: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 8787 --local-upstream 127.0.0.1:8787
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.www.jsonc
